pages.text: Water covers much of the world. Oceans hold ocean monuments (YUNG's Better Ocean Monuments), shipwrecks and ruins; warm oceans have coral reefs, and frozen ones icebergs and polar bears. Dolphins swim alongside boats, turtles nest on beaches, and Naturalist adds $(bold)whales$() and $(bold)great white sharks$() out at sea.$(br2)Drowned sometimes carry tridents. A trident needs $(bold)Ranged 40$() to use. See $(l:lemursaucepacket:skills)Skills$(/l).
